hu.text: A Monumento Bíblia Sagrada egy köztéri emlékmű Vitóriában, amely egy nyitott Szent Bibliát ábrázol.

ro.name: Estação Leopoldina

ro.text: Acest golf extins înconjoară orașul-insulă Vitória și joacă un rol vital în comerțul maritim al regiunii.

ro.text: Această formațiune stâncoasă fascinantă în formă de ochi din Vitória este un punct de belvedere popular pentru drumeții și alpiniști.

ro.name: Morro de Argolas

ro.text: Găzduit într-un conac rural din secolul al XIX-lea, acest muzeu din Vitória ilustrează viața agricolă colonială a regiunii.

ro.name: Monumento Bíblia Sagrada

en.name: Museu Vale
en.text: Located in the old Pedro Nolasco station, this former railway museum documents the history of the Vitória-Minas railway.

en.name: Igreja Cristã Maranata - Maanaim de Cariacica
en.text: This large Maranata Christian assembly center in Cariacica serves as a major venue for religious seminars and gatherings.

en.name: Igreja Cristã Maranata
en.text: Part of the Brazilian-founded Maranata denomination, this church offers regular worship services in the busy port region of Vitória.

en.name: A Igreja de Jesus Cristo dos Santos dos Últimos Dias
en.text: This meetinghouse for The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints is an active spiritual center for Mormons in the greater Vitória area.

en.name: Catedral Metropolitana de Vitória
en.text: Showcasing impressive Neo-Gothic architecture and colorful stained glass, this metropolitan cathedral towers over Vitória's historic Dom Luiz Scortegagna square.

en.name: SESC Glória
en.text: Originally known as the Teatro Glória, this historic arts center operates within a striking Art Deco building in Vitória.

en.name: Mercado da Capixaba
en.text: Built in 1926, this historic marketplace in Vitória features eclectic architecture and traditionally hosts local craft vendors.

en.name: Farol de Santa Luzia
en.text: Imported from Scotland in 1871, this octagonal metal lighthouse guides ships at the entrance to Espírito Santo Bay.

en.name: Palácio Anchieta
en.text: Originally built as a Jesuit church, the Palácio Anchieta in Vitória now serves as the seat of the state government of Espírito Santo.

en.name: Parque Natural Municipal Morro da Manteigueira
en.text: This municipal nature reserve in Vila Velha protects remnants of the Atlantic Forest and a crucial estuarine mangrove ecosystem.

en.name: Parque Pedra da Cebola
en.text: This urban park in Vitória is famous for its distinctive resting-onion-shaped rock formation nestled amidst landscaped gardens.

en.name: Prefeitura Municipal de Vila Velha
en.text: This administrative building serves as the municipal headquarters for Vila Velha, managing the civic affairs of the historic city.

en.name: Museu de Arte do Espírito Santo
en.text: Housed in a historic building in downtown Vitória, the MAES art museum exhibits works by both regional and national Brazilian artists.

en.name: Prefeitura Municipal de Cariacica
en.text: Serving as the civic center of Cariacica, this town hall coordinates the municipal services and administrative operations for the community.

en.name: Relógio da Praça Oito
en.text: Inaugurated in 1942 on Praça Oito de Setembro, this historic clock tower is famous for chiming the official anthem of Espírito Santo.

en.name: Estação Leopoldina
en.text: Repurposed from a historic railway station, this building in Vitória now functions as a dynamic arts center for cultural performances.

en.name: Baía do Espírito Santo
en.text: Surrounding the island capital of Vitória, this expansive bay plays a vital role in the region's maritime trade and coastal scenery.

en.name: Morro da Manteigueira
en.text: Rising above the municipal nature reserve of the same name in Vila Velha, this peak is covered in dense Atlantic Forest vegetation.

en.name: Pedra dos Olhos
en.text: This striking, eye-shaped rock formation is a prominent peak in Vitória, frequently attracting hikers and local rock climbers.

en.name: Morro do Paul
en.text: Situated in the Paul district, this peak offers expansive views over the port facilities of Vila Velha and the Bay of Vitória.

en.name: Morro de Argolas
en.text: Rising steeply in Vila Velha, this heavily urbanized peak overlooks the historic Florentino Avidos bridge.

en.name: Parque Municipal Don Luiz Gonzaga Fernandes
en.text: Featuring shaded walkways, this municipal park provides a green recreational oasis amidst the urban landscape of Vitória.

en.name: Praia de Itaparica

descriptionAdvanced.de: Der Hafen von Vitória ist der wichtigste Hafenkomplex des Bundesstaates Espírito Santo und liegt in einer malerischen Bucht, die die Insel Vitória vom Festland trennt. Er wurde zu Beginn des 20. Jahrhunderts als moderner Exporthafen für Kaffee konzipiert und hat sich seither zu einem vielseitigen Logistikzentrum entwickelt. Heute umfasst der Komplex neben dem öffentlichen Hafen von Vitória auch den privaten Hafen von Tubarão, der einer der weltweit größten Terminals für den Export von Eisenerz ist. Geografisch ist die Hafeneinfahrt durch ihre Enge und die umliegenden Granitfelsen, wie den Morro do Moreno, besonders markant. Wirtschaftlich spielt Vitória eine entscheidende Rolle für den Export von Stahl, Zellulose und Granit sowie für den Import von Fahrzeugen und Konsumgütern. Die moderne Infrastruktur und die Anbindung an die Eisenbahnlinie Vitória-Minas machen ihn zu einem hocheffizienten Bindeglied zwischen den Minen von Minas Gerais und den Weltmärkten.
descriptionAdvanced.hu: Vitória kikötője Espírito Santo állam legfontosabb kikötőkomplexuma, amely egy festői öbölben található, elválasztva Vitória szigetét a szárazföldtől. A 20. század elején modern kávéexportáló kikötőként hozták létre, és azóta sokoldalú logisztikai központtá fejlődött. Ma a komplexum Vitória nyilvános kikötője mellett magában foglalja a Tubarão magánkikötőt is, amely a világ egyik legnagyobb vasércexportáló terminálja. Földrajzilag a kikötő bejárata rendkívül jellegzetes a szűkössége és a környező gránitsziklák, például a Morro do Moreno miatt. Gazdaságilag Vitória döntő szerepet játszik az acél, a cellulóz és a gránit exportjában, valamint a járművek és fogyasztási cikkek importjában. A modern infrastruktúra és a Vitória-Minas vasútvonalhoz való csatlakozás rendkívül hatékony összeköttetést biztosít Minas Gerais bányái és a világpiacok között.
descriptionAdvanced.ro: Portul Vitória este cel mai important complex portuar din statul Espírito Santo, fiind situat într-un golf pitoresc care separă insula Vitória de continent. A fost conceput la începutul secolului XX ca un port modern pentru exportul de cafea și s-a transformat de atunci într-un centru logistic versatil. Astăzi, complexul include portul public Vitória și portul privat Tubarão, acesta din urmă fiind unul dintre cele mai mari terminale de export de minereu de fier din lume. Din punct de vedere geografic, intrarea în port este spectaculoasă datorită lățimii reduse și a stâncilor de granit înconjurătoare, precum Morro do Moreno. Economic, Vitória joacă un rol crucial în exportul de oțel, celuloză și granit, dar și în importul de vehicule și bunuri de larg consum. Infrastructura modernă și conexiunea cu calea ferată Vitória-Minas îl fac o verigă extrem de eficientă între minele din statul Minas Gerais și piețele internaționale.
descriptionAdvanced.en: The Port of Vitória is the primary port complex of Espírito Santo state, situated within a scenic bay that separates Vitória Island from the mainland. Established in the early 20th century as a specialized coffee export facility, it has since evolved into a diverse and multi-purpose logistical hub. Today, the complex comprises the public Port of Vitória and the private Port of Tubarão, the latter being one of the world's largest terminals for iron ore exportation. Geographically, the port's entrance is notable for its narrow passage flanked by towering granite formations such as Morro do Moreno. Economically, Vitória is critical for the export of steel, cellulose, and granite, as well as the importation of vehicles and consumer goods. Its modern infrastructure, integrated with the Vitória-Minas Railway, provides a highly efficient link between the mining districts of Minas Gerais and global markets.
descriptionAdvanced.es: El puerto de Vitória es un elemento notable de la geografía y la cultura brasileñas. Un importante complejo portuario en Espírito Santo, conocido por el transporte de mineral de hierro y productos siderúrgicos. Este sitio desempeña un papel en la economía de Brasil, que está fuertemente marcada por el café, la soja, la caña de azúcar y el mineral de hierro. Como muchos lugares importantes de Brasil, este sitio combina las peculiaridades regionales con la importancia global del quinto país más grande del mundo. De este modo, este lugar contribuye al perfil versátil de Brasil, donde la naturaleza tropical, la herencia portuguesa, el samba, el fútbol y el carnaval se entrelazan.
descriptionAdvanced.pt: O Porto de Vitória é um elemento notável da geografia e cultura brasileiras. Um importante complexo portuário no Espírito Santo, conhecido pela movimentação de minério de ferro e produtos siderúrgicos. Este local desempenha um papel na economia do Brasil, que é fortemente marcada pelo café, soja, cana-de-açúcar e minério de ferro. Como muitos lugares importantes no Brasil, este local combina peculiaridades regionais com a importância global do quinto maior país do mundo. Assim, este lugar contribui para o perfil versátil do Brasil, onde a natureza tropical, a herança portuguesa, o samba, o futebol e o carnaval se entrelaçam.
descriptionAdvanced.fr: Le port de Vitória est un élément remarquable de la géographie et de la culture brésiliennes. Un complexe portuaire majeur à Espírito Santo, connu pour le transbordement de minerai de fer et de produits sidérurgiques. Ce site joue un rôle dans l'économie du Brésil, qui est fortement marquée par le café, le soja, la canne à sucre et le minerai de fer. Comme beaucoup de lieux importants au Brésil, ce site combine des particularités régionales avec l'importance globale du cinquième plus grand pays du monde. Ainsi, ce lieu contribue au profil polyvalent du Brésil, où la nature tropicale, l'héritage portugais, la samba, le football et le carnaval s'entremêlent.
